name: GL_JE_BATCHES_
description: GL_JE_BATCHES contains journal entry batches.  Each row includes the batch name, description, status, running total debits and credits, and other information.  This table corresponds to the Batch window of the Enter Journals form. STATUS is 'U' for unposted, 'P' for posted, 'S' for selected, 'I' for in the process of being posted.  Other values of status indicate an error condition. STATUS_VERIFIED is 'N' when you create or modify an unposted journal entry batch.  The posting program changes STATUS_VERIFIED to 'I' when posting is in process and 'Y' after posting is complete.
